test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Observe the bar graph showing the number of students in different sections of a school and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/047465356df5f9382d94fe198093d1a4f4a26766689bc07f8d81df01b002577f.png] 

Which section has nearly the average number of students when compared with all the 6 sections of the graph?
solution:
**SOLUTION:**

The average number of students in 6 sections = 60 + 30 + 20 + 40 + 70 + 50 / 6 = 45

Average number of 4 and 5 sections = 40 + 70 / 2 = 55

Average number of 4 and 6 sections = 40 + 50 / 2 = 45

Average number of 2 and 3 sections = 30 + 20 / 2 = 25

Average number of 1 and 3 sections = 60 + 20 / 2 = 40

Hence option 2 is the valid answer.
